description:
Indies Expansion Pack 2 - Stable Early Access
Mod that add bunch of stuff to Indies and its less reputable cousin...
NOW ONLY AVAILABLE FOR 0.98

REWORK IN PROGESS -- WIP -- Stable Early Access Version Available

DONT FORGET TO DELETE OLD MOD BEFORE UPDATING IT TO NEWER ONE

*Updated Preview

Currently Implemented Ship, Wings & Weapons (On Both Modules)

Some Weapon Preview (more to come)

Spoiler

Some Hullmods and Industry Preview

Spoiler

Because this originally meant for personal playthrough mod, balance is number two, but it will gradually improved as i fix many things inside here and there, with primary focus of implementing the things i want and balance it later, still mostly wip mod, but serviceable? (hopefully), do tell me if something break  ;).

So what it is offer?

An ship that spawn an deployable defense frigates/stationary
Bunch of indies-esque scav ship ranging from small frigates to capital ship
An Medium Long Range Arty that explode upon impact (WIP to make it Shootable)
A 0 OP ballistic & energy pd that exist just to fill slot
An exploration frigates that get bonuses maintenance and extra fuel effect if its the only ship on your fleet (For single exploration run, literally dram but an actual exploration vessel)
An Hullmod for carrier with salvage rig that make frigates wont consume fuel and supply in exchage of being dependent of said carrier.

Safe to add to existing saves, not safe to remove.

Download Here:

Credits:

-Alex: ofc  ;D

Changelog

Future Plan?

Spoiler

discordPostHtml:
[0.97a] Indies Expansion Pack v.3.1

REQUIRE NEW SAVES

Mod that add bunch of stuff to Indies and its less reputable cousin...

-An hullmod that turn your manned ship min crew to 0 in exchange of being dependent of ship with control hullmod (beware it disabled ur ship if its command ship die!)
-An ship that spawn an deployable defense frigates/stationary
-Bunch of indies-esque scav ship ranging from small frigates to capital ship
-An Frontier System, inhabited with pirates and indies, serve as base of exploration in four edges of sector
-An Medium Long Range Arty that explode upon impact (WIP to make it Shootable)
-An Colony Structure that turn your colony hidden (Ie: cant be raided or attacked | also WIP)
-A 0 OP ballistic pd that exist just to fill slot
-An exploration frigates that get bonuses maintance and extra fuel effect if its the only ship on your fleet (For single exploration run, literally dram but an actual exploration vessel)
-An Hullmod for carrier with salvage rig that make frigates wont consume fuel and supply in exchage of being dependent of said carrier.
-A DAKKA hellbore
-Ability to STORE frigate IN CARRIER (A hullmod)

v3.1 Update (FIX!! / REQUIRE NEW SAVES)

Link:

9.6: -

9.7 (New FIXED?): https://www.mediafire.com/file/b6egh27qnai9zjl/IeP_3.1_-_Mod_ver_Fix.zip/file

REQUIRE NEW SAVES, i assume base on several report log from player, that the cause of crash and save breaking happen because the way game handle mod info ver. ,

Apparently i forgot to change the previous mod info ver from 2.0. to 2.1, which probably cause confusion for the game, given that there is alot change in 2.1 and actual removed stuff that require itself a new saves.

Forum link & Preview:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=28377.0
aiDescription: Adds a variety of scavenger-themed ships ranging from frigates to capital ships, along with new weapons and hullmods. The mod also introduces industry structures and frontier systems, though some features are currently marked as work-in-progress.
